# Xianyu 咸鱼酒馆 — live music bar in Taman Desa, Kuala Lumpur

> Official site of Xianyu 咸鱼酒馆, a laid-back Mandopop live music bar in Taman Desa, Kuala Lumpur (off Old Klang Road, south of Mid Valley). Live band every night. Bookings by WhatsApp; walk-ins welcome daily.

- Website: https://xianyukl.com/
- Chinese: 吉隆坡华语现场音乐酒吧

- Address: Unit A-G-03, Union Tower, Jalan Desa Bakti, Taman Desa, 58000 Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
- Phone / WhatsApp: +60 12-652 2885
- Hours: 6:30pm–2:30am daily; live band 9:30pm–12:45am every night; kitchen till 1am
- Happy hour: before 8:30pm, Sunday to Thursday, not on public-holiday eves. Beer bucket buy 1 free 1; Guinness 10 glasses RM175
- Birthday: members claim a free mini cake or Flaming Lamborghini in Xianyu Play, 3 days either side of their birthday, and the band sings
- Membership: Xianyu Play, free at https://xianyu.pingan.today/ (Malaysian phone number, nothing to download). Every RM100 on the bill earns 1 chip; fries 1 chip, any cocktail or mocktail 5 chips, Tiger bucket (5 bottles) 10 chips, Moët & Chandon 60 chips; one reward a night
- This week's line-up (singers each night): https://xianyukl.com/#week
- Parking: plenty of spaces outside, plus an indoor car park
- Age policy: strictly 18+ at all hours; no kids
- Minimum spend: sofas on Fri/Sat/public-holiday-eve nights only — RM500 sofa (max 7 guests) or RM1,000 big sofa (max 12 guests); no sofa minimum on weekdays or the public-holiday day itself
- Navigation: search "Xian Yu KL" on Waze or Grab
- Instagram: https://instagram.com/xianyu.kl
- Google Maps: https://maps.app.goo.gl/R8NTbLVmtterrdzh8
- Page: https://xianyukl.com/
- Bookings: WhatsApp with date, time and pax. No deposit; tables are held about 15 minutes.
- No smoking indoors.
- Beer kept 30 days.
- [food menu (PDF)](https://xianyukl.com/assets/menu/food.pdf)
- [drinks menu (PDF)](https://xianyukl.com/assets/menu/drinks.pdf)
